title: Blind-score A vs B and test Mario activation boundary
description: Independently evaluate variant A and B without using producer conclusions. Replay validation/render commands, score every rubric dimension and surface, test grayscale/contrast/semantic consistency and the B-without-flag negative control, and write evaluation.json plus a concise reveal report only after scoring. Acceptance: all hard gates have evidence; arithmetic totals to 100; per-surface deltas are reported; B passes only if >=15 total improvement, no surface regression, and no unflagged Mario leakage. Human-only criterion 'Mario would publish this' remains explicitly pending.
